text: RESULTS: Mammography shows a smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast. Biopsy microscopic description reveals leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth, consistent with a Phyllodes tumor. Vital signs are within normal limits: Temperature 37.0°C, Blood Pressure 125/80 mmHg, Heart Rate 72 bpm, Respiratory Rate 14 breaths/min. Breast examination confirms a 6-cm, nontender, multinodular mass in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast with no palpable lymphadenopathy.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth confirm a Phyllodes tumor, which aligns with your rapidly growing, painless mass.
